home.quoteText: Design is really an act of communication, which means having a deep understanding of the person with whom the designer is communicating.
home.quoteAuthor: — Don Norman, The Design of Everyday Things

nosotros.heroSub: A deliberate design studio focused on experience and detail.
nosotros.whoBody: Celsius Studio was born from the conviction that good design is not decorative — it is functional, intentional, and transforms the way people relate to what they use.
nosotros.howBody: Every project starts by understanding the root problem. We design from logic, iterate with the client, and deliver something that works — not just something that looks good.
